summary: Focused frontend regression completed at 390px. Storm-glass hero, globe, rain/lightning motion, persona sync, location sync, navigation close behavior, and post-flow overflow pass. Editorial mobile menu contrast is fixed, but the open menu is positioned 25px off the left edge.

ui_bugs.issue: When opened at 390px, computed bounds are left=-25px and right=365px. The dark surface and white labels are readable, but the menu is clipped on the left and leaves a 25px gap on the right.

action_items: Correct the mobile nav.open positioning/containing block so its bounds are 0..390px at 390px viewport while preserving the dark editorial surface.
critical_code_review_comments: Weather values and partly-cloudy state remain intentionally MOCKED; no live weather API is connected, as requested.
The partly-cloudy state is hard-coded in data-weather-state; future live-condition integration must drive that attribute and effect intensity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390px, onboarding was dismissed through the UI. Motion/globe, contrast, persona Health sync, Hyderabad location sync, navigation close, and no-overflow after sync were exercised. Recheck nav.open bounds after positioning fix. rca of the issue: The theme-specific nav surface/text override works (computed background rgba(12,39,43,0.94), text rgb(255,255,255)). The remaining defect is geometric: nav.open computes to left=-25px, width=390px, right=365px at 390px, indicating an offset/containing-block or horizontal positioning interaction in the mobile header.
